description:
Create an organization

Creates a new `ORG`-kind organization with the caller as its first `OWNER`. Every user gets a default organization at sign-up, and it counts toward their org-creation limit (1 active organization unless Reclaim support raises it). Past the limit this returns `409`; contact support@reclaimprotocol.org to raise the limit or archive an organization.

body.description: Body for `POST /orgs` — just a name. Every org is created keyless, like each user's default org; its Ethereum (secp256k1) key pair is published separately via `PUT /orgs/{orgId}/keypair`, which is also where `canEncryptResult` is set. Creation deliberately collects nothing else so it never blocks on generating and safeguarding a private key.

name: create_org
